claim: A thorium reactor control loop that checks @heat less often than the time it takes to go from its threshold to 0.999 can explode between two checks.
why: heating=0.01/tick ⇒ 0→0.999 is 100 ticks at full fuel, 600 ticks at 5/30 fuel. The check interval is loop-body statements ÷ ipt. 11 of 51 distinct corpus programs exceed their own window.
